(171)lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma la/gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal te/sems la phan pa'i gros gcig gdab/nam yang rang gi rgyud la sbyor/deng sang snyigs ma'

tei:div.tei:p: (171)lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma la/ gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal te/ sems la phan pa'i gros gcig gdab/ nam yang rang gi rgyud la sbyor/ deng sang snyigs ma'i mar zhabs 'dir/ chos pa'i gzugs brnyan mang mod kyang*/ tshul bzhin sgrub pa nyin skar tsam/ lam gnad shes pa de bas dkon/ gong ma brgyud pa'i man ngag bzhin/ rtag tu rang gi sems la brtags/ mi dge'i bsam pa dug bzhin spong*/ dge ba byang chub sems mchog 'di/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sa bon lags/ lus ngag dge ba gang sgrub pa/ rnam mkhyen lam du 'gro ba dgos/ dal 'byor snying po chos kyis blangs/ mi rtag 'chi ba'i dran bskul gyis/ tshe 'dir zhen pa ma log na/ spros bral mthon po'i stong skad dang*/ bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rlom sems 'dis/ dman pa'i skye bo phal cher bslu/ gzhi ma ma ner tshul khrims gtsang*/ blo rtse ma nor dkon mchog gsum/ yid ches 'gyur med dad pa (172)brtan/ med thabs med pa'i chos gsum lags/ lho zong byang du skyel ba dang*/ byang zong lho ru 'don pa dang*/ rkang leb bran du bkol ba dang*/ 'di gsum chos pa'i rlung khyer yin/ ma mthong mngon shes 'chad pa dang*/ nus med lha 'dre de bdo dang*/ rmang po sri'u gos ba gsum/ 'di gsum chos pa'i pad khyer yin/ sdig zas khra bo sha dang gcig myos byed ser mo'i chang dang nyis/ bslu byed na chung reg dang gsum/ 'di gsum chos pa'i btsan dug yin/ rgyal ba'i lam mchog ma nor ba/ zab rgyas gnyis kyi gdams pa'i bcud/ yongs 'dus kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung*/ rnam mang mkhas pas bzung ba'i gzhung*/ shing rta gsum gyi legs bshad la/ shes rab gsum gyi mig bsgrun nas/ ji bzhin nyams su len nus na/ lam ma nor 'chug yod re kan/ gzhan du rtog ge'i rtsal bshad dang*/ blun bsgom snyan brgyud bcos ma gnyis/ rdzun gter zog po'i bslu brid gsum/ thar 'dod rnams kyi bdud du che/

kye ma rang mgo chos (173)kyis thon/ bden gnyis 'byed pa'i shes rab zhig med thabs med pas thos pa tshol/ de don bsam pas skyong ba dang*/ bsgom pas brtan pa thon pa dgos/ rgyud la blo skyed ma thon bar/ chos la yar skyed bton pa na/ chos gzhung shor ba'i chos pa de/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bla btsong yin/ des na 'di snang zhen pa yi/ chos brgyad lam kha'i ro bzhin dor/ rang gzhan grub mtha'i chags sdang gis/ thar med 'khor ba'i gting rdo byed/ phyogs med grub mtha'i khog khrol zhing*/ rnam dag lam gyi dmigs phye nas/ lta sgom kha khyer ma che bar/ rang rgyud gyong po 'dul ba la/ bslab pa gsum gyi skya bar nas/ gong ma'i rjes su ci snyogs kyis/ rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len dang*/ thal 'gyur dbu ma'i mtho skad de/ rang gi rgyud la 'byor dka' bas/ thun mongs blo ldog nas bzung ste/ zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bar/ thun re bzhin du blo sbyongs dang*/ nyin re bzhin du nyams len ltos/ tshad med bzhi dang byang chub (174)sems/ mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ dbang bzhi blang zhing thugs yid bsres/ rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes 'di/ kho thag nang nas chod pa la/ cog bzhag chen po'i dgongs pa skyongs/ rang grol spyod pas bogs dbyung na/ kun bzang chos sku'i rgyal thabs la/ 'bad med ngang gis phyin par 'gyur/

skal mgon ngor tshul khrims rgya mtshos so// (175)bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'chi bar bya phyir skye 'gyur bas/ skye ba'i sngon nas 'chi bas bsgugs/ 'di las nam yang bros pa med/ 'du shes 'di la nan tan 'bad/ nang pa sangs rgyas chos rnams kyi/ nang na 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ yang du blo la bsam sbyang na/ dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu/ bar du lam las mi ldog cing*/ tha ma mnyam pa nyid rtogs par/ thog mtha' bar du dge bar 'gyur/ mi rtag dran bskul ma bsam nas/ gong ma theg pa'i mtho skad kyis/ dman pa'i shes rgyud chud zos nas/ rang rgyud chos dang ma 'dres par/ ltar snang bcos ma'i rang sems bslu/ 'chi ba rgyud la ma skyes na/ chos rjogs pa chen po zab rgyu med/ snying nas mi rtag yid ches na/ chos gang byed thar ba'i lam du 'gro deng sang snyigs ma'i mar zhabs 'dir/ kha khyer chos la byed med kyang*/ lam du 'gro ba shin tu nyung*/ gcig du lam gnad shes pa dkon/ gnyis su 'dir snang ma chod dang*/ (176)gsum na brtson 'grus zhan che bas/ mi tshe ri la bskyal gyur kyang*/ 'chi khar chos med 'gro ba mang*/ thos pa mang pos shes bya'i mtha'/ spros pa chod snyam bgyid na yang*/ don med tshig 'khri bden zhen gyis/ 'ching ba 'di las che ba med/ grwa pa'i dge bshes bong rna can/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal ches grags pas/ mngon gsum tshad ma smra bzhin du/ dud 'gro'i mngal du 'jug pa thob/ thos pas tshig mtha' mi chod par/ bsam pas don la sgro 'dogs bcad/ bsgom pas nyams myong ci skye dgos/ shes rab rnam gsum ya bral nas/ u tshug bsgom pa gcig pu 'dis/ phal cher dud 'gro'i gnas su 'gro rgyu 'bras nges pa'i gtan tshig gis/ gzhal bya bslu ba yod re kan/ thos pa rnam rtog g.yeng ba'i grogs/ bsgom pa 'du shes med pa'i rgyu/ nyon mongs gnyen por ma song ba'i/ thos bsgom gnyis pos rang sems bslu/ des na lam gyi gzugs brnyan spang*/

snyan brgyud chu bo la (177)nub cing*/ smin byed dbang gis rgyud smin nas/ dam tshig lam gyi srog tu bzung*/ mos gus bsgom gyi mgo bo yin/ dran pa bsgom gyi snying rdo yin/ brtson 'grus bsgom gyi rkang pa yin/ gsungs pas de gsum yid la gyis/ bsags sbyangs lam dang ma 'brel ba'i/ u tshug bsgom pas sa mi chod/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mthong gis/ dad gus zhe nas ma skyes na/ rang gar ne tso'i 'don pa ltar/ mos gus med pas byin rlabs med/ gong ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs par/ rtogs pa'i ye shes 'dod pa de/ byang bstan phug pa'i nyi ma bzhin/ dgongs pa'i byin rlabs 'pho dus med/ byin rlabs bum pa gang byo bzhin/ gong mas 'og ma brlab pa dgos/ de min nyam snang za zi dang*/ nyams kyi rlung sna 'khyil ba la/ rtogs pa mtho sgros brtags na 'khrul/ rang skyon nang nas ngos ma zin/ thos pa tshig phyir 'brang nas su/ grub mtha'i mtho khyad 'don pa 'di/ shes rab 'chal (178)ba'i rgyu yin spang*/ spyir na gong ma'i zha rgyun du/ thos don bsam pas skyong ba dang*/ bsam don bsgom pas myong ba ni/ nges par dgos par gsungs na yang*/ ji bzhin 'ong ba re re tsam/ chos brgyad rtog pa'i bslu brid la/ zhen pa nang nas ma log par/ mkhas dang grub pa'i go pa la/ snyegs pa rang mgo rang gis bskor/ shing rta gnyis nas legs brgyud pa/ zab rgyas gnyis kyi gdams pa'i gnad/ yang dag lam gyi dmigs byas nas/ bsgom pa'i skyes bu skal ba bzang*/ sa lam mngon rtogs ci skye yang*/ rlom pa'i nga rgyal ma che bar/ rnam dag gzhung dang zhu tig gyis/ rang rgyud nyen mongs kha phri zhing*/ 'bras bu byams dang snying rje dang*/ byang chub sems la blo 'gro na/ dam pa'i blo dang mthun par 'dug de min mngon shes grub rtags dang*/ snyan grags bdud kyi phye gtor gyis/ chos sa phal cher bslus bslus na/ bsam pa zhib mos rtog dpyod thongs/

rang rgyud btul na thul bar mchi/ gzhan gyi btul na cod pa 'byung*/ rang gi bshes gnyen rang gi bgyis/ (179)dran dang shes bzhin bag yod kyis/ nam yang rang gi sems la rtog thar ba'i lam dang mthun par gyis/ zhal gdams zer ba'i shog byang gcig ha cang yin mdog ma che bar/ gzhung lugs thams cad gdams ngag tu/ go ba med na ci mi rung*/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med par/ gang zag gcig gi nyams len khyer/ gzhan zer tshig gi rjes rgyug dang*/ nyams len blun po'i sems 'jin 'di/ don med 'khor bar 'ching ba'i rgyu/ byang chub sems kyi ma zin na/ dam chos ci byed gyi nar gda'/ stong nyid lta bas ma zin na/ nyams len ci byed 'khor ba'i rgyu/ thabs dang shes rab ya bral du/ spros bral khas len med pa'i mtha'/ mthon por 'jin pa'i go skabs 'dis/ bstan pa rming nas dkrugs par zad/ rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa'i gnas/ bden gnyis ci yang 'thad pas na/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa me blag tu/ kho thag nang nas chod pa yi/ 'gal 'du'i dri mas ma bslad pa/ rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam (180)lam bzang po/ zab pa dang ni rgya chen po'i/ gzhung bzang snang ba'i gter chen po/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung*/ shing rta gsum dang mjod chen bdun/ thos bsam bsgom pas skyong nus na/ gzhan du nor ba yod re kan/ gzhan yang rtog ge'i rtsal bshad dang*/ mi shes rmongs pa'i snyan brgyud gnyis/ rnam rtog spros pa phyir mchod pas/ lam ngan de dag zhog la thongs/ ces pa'ang bsgrub brtson dam pa a ska nyi mas bskul ngor pad+ma las 'brel gyis so/// /
